column2: This dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh, for {period}. It supports monitoring of health information system service delivery across public and private facilities, and rural and urban facility availability. Figures are provisional and status notes are included. The source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

This dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for health management information from sub-districts in West, Delhi, for {period}. It is intended for monitoring public and private health facility performance over time, using provisional figures. Updates are monthly, aligned with HMIS reporting schedules by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

HMIS Item-wise Monthly Reports compiled for sub-districts in Yadgir, Karnataka, for {period}. The reports support monitoring of health service delivery and workload by capturing item-wise indicators over time. Data are sourced from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and are published for Central government use, updated monthly.

This dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in Zunheboto, Nagaland, for {period}. It supports health service planning and performance monitoring by tracking item-wise indicators over time. Data are compiled from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare, at sub-district level, published with monthly updates.

Monthly facility-performance report for public facilities handling C-section deliveries, for {period}, aggregated and presented range-wise. It helps monitor service delivery performance, reporting completeness, and facility-level functioning across eligible districts on the HMIS portal. Prepared under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, focusing on district-level facility-wise uploads and excluding medical colleges. Data scope is facility-active and physically existing facilities.
